reasoning: A classic closed padlock outline with a central dot keyhole. Universally recognized for both physical locks (padlocks, deadbolts, locking up a house/shed) and digital security (passwords, 2FA, privacy, credit freezes). Wait out for physical keys (which have their own key icon) and metaphorical uses like 'lock in a rate'.
